resources.string: Keep Monica open and unlocked on both devices. Automatic discovery and connections pause in the background.
Open and unlock both apps. Small system discovery messages continue while waiting.

Passkeys with nonzero signature counters are skipped. Non-exportable keys sync only credential metadata. Other limits may require registering a new Passkey on the destination. Hiding this reminder does not change these rules.
